name: breakhis-specialist-reader-v1
primary_comparison: validation-selected uni2_specialist versus validation-selected p_control; both have four malignant-temperature choices and the identical fixed P binary router

input_audit.policy: reuse exact parent roles, case order, field membership and original truth8/truth5; no new fold or seed

field_alignment.coverage: all 7909 canonical fields; unique bijection for both caches, including all four views for every case
field_alignment.cache_order: lookup by path; never zip cache positions

router.fitting: current 49 training cases only; per-view binary center is equal mean of benign-case and malignant-case group means; class/case/field-balanced binary KDE

references.pin_policy: resolve every cache shard, metadata, encoder revision and extraction provenance through these exact hashed configurations; no large pin-list duplication

p_control.crop: accepted mean of three crop descriptors
p_control.center: per view: fitting raw-field mean per malignant case, equal mean of case means within each malignant subtype, then equal mean over four subtype centers
p_control.normalization: subtract current malignant head-specific center; L2 normalize in float64

uni2_specialist.center: per view: raw-field mean per each of 49 fitting cases in float64, then equal mean over all 49 case means; retain accepted UNI2 C geometry
uni2_specialist.normalization: subtract current equal-case center; L2 normalize in float64

density.weights: within each same-view subtype density, every support case receives equal mass and each field mass 1/(n_cases_subtype*n_fields_case_view)

prediction.pooling: arithmetic mean of joint probabilities over fields within a view, then equal mean over available views
prediction.routing: pooled P(M)>=0.5 then malignant argmax, otherwise benign

selection.metric: mean15 final-five macro F1 with all five labels
selection.seal: seal selected index, temperature, artifacts and source/config/cache/input hashes for BOTH arms before any retrospective test query
selection.parent_selection_history: parent P used four shared binary/malignant temperatures; this family fixes binary 0.1 and adds four malignant-only choices for EACH arm

identity.role: validation only before selection; retrospective test compares fixed binary marginals without evaluating another specialist candidate

follow_up.role: existing viewed test; retrospective reused-development only

artifacts: eight validation candidate probability archives and metrics
two selected retrospective follow-up archives if executed
independent checker report including every negative outcome
interpretation: A bounded frozen specialist-reader package comparison, motivated by pre-matched reader evidence. P three-crop versus UNI2 center coverage, pretraining, feature dimensions and centering differ. Not a pure backbone ablation, optimized learning method, novelty claim or fresh clinical test. Binary performance is fixed for both arms and cannot improve toward >97%; >90% final-five remains an unmet objective until correctly measured.
